target_statement: For every positive ordinary decimal seed n and every natural threshold B, the lower asymptotic density and lower Banach density of {t : Nat | B < DecimalMass.digitSum (Lychrel196.orbit n t)} are at least 1/(DecimalUniformEscape.sharpDigitSumEscapeBound B + 1), as inequalities of real numbers. Also prove the generic analytic consequence of the existing translated interval-count bound.

density_contract.interval: [s,s+N), counted by the unchanged Agent9 intervalCount; N=0 has ratio 0
density_contract.asymptotic: Filter.liminf of count(0,N)/N atTop, valued in Real
density_contract.banach: Filter.liminf atTop of the infimum over all natural translates s of count(s,N)/N; prove uniform real epsilon bound as well
density_contract.quantifiers: All positive n, all natural B including 0; all translates s; orbit continues after palindromes.
